cohort: Women who underwent emergency obstetric hysterectomy between January 2018 and April 2021 at Smt. Hira Kunwar Ba Mahila Hospital, Jhalawar, India.
finding: The overall incidence of emergency obstetric hysterectomy was 0.4/1000 deliveries, with uterine rupture (38.5%), postpartum hemorrhage (30.8%), and morbidly adherent placenta (30.8%) being the most common indications.
